purpose: BRANCH-SCOPE-01 B0-02 before-baseline; invariant 4 proof and B6 parity reference. Read-only capture.

definitions.students: user rows with role=student; direct user.branch_id
definitions.invoicesCount: invoices rows; via the owning student (user.branch_id); count + sum(net_amount)
definitions.invoicesSum: sum of invoices.net_amount via the owning student
definitions.paymentsPostedSum: sum of payments.amount where status=posted, via the owning student
definitions.attendanceThisMonth: attendance rows with date >= first day of the capture month (computed in Node), via the owning student

queries.tenants: select id, name from tenants order by name
queries.branches: select id, tenant_id, name, code, is_active, is_default from branches order by tenant_id, name
queries.students:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
             from "user" where role = 'student' and tenant_id is not null group by 1, 2
queries.classes:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
            from classes group by 1, 2
queries.applicants:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
               from applicants group by 1, 2
queries.invoices:
select i.tenant_id, coalesce(u.branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket,
                    count(*)::int as n, coalesce(sum(i.net_amount), 0)::float8 as s
             from invoices i left join "user" u on u.id = i.student_id group by 1, 2
queries.payments:
select p.tenant_id, coalesce(u.branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket,
                    coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0)::float8 as s
             from payments p left join "user" u on u.id = p.student_id
             where p.status = 'posted' group by 1, 2
queries.attendance:
select a.tenant_id, coalesce(u.branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
               from attendance a left join "user" u on u.id = a.student_id
               where a.date >= $1 group by 1, 2
queries.employees:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
              from employee_profiles group by 1, 2
queries.libraryCopies:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
                  from library_copies group by 1, 2
queries.hostelBeds:
select h.tenant_id, coalesce(h.branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(b.id)::int as n
               from hostel_beds b
               join hostel_rooms r on r.id = b.room_id
               join hostels h on h.id = r.hostel_id
               group by 1, 2
queries.transportRoutes:
select tenant_id, coalesce(branch_id::text, '_unassigned') as bucket, count(*)::int as n
                    from transport_routes group by 1, 2
